originality.rationale: The 2026 source computes uniform intersections only for cyclic-kernel ordinary dihedral groups; the 2019 primary source computes minimum intersections there. The new formula concerns every nontrivial odd abelian kernel and explicitly counts all maximum containment fibers for noncyclic Sylow rank. Searches of relevant mathematical records for equivalent formulations and stronger general coverage did not identify an exact result. Generalized-dihedral independence-graph work uses the same quotient but a different invariant. Historical priority under alternate terminology remains a disclosed risk.

value.rationale: The uniform intersection number is the natural worst-choice counterpart of minimal Frattini intersection. This theorem determines both over the entire odd-abelian-kernel generalized-dihedral family, strictly beyond the previously known cyclic case, and quantifies the noncyclic rank effect. Already for fixed rank two the separation grows arbitrarily with the odd prime, a meaningful group-theoretic structural phenomenon not implied by the cyclic theorem.
